detail.name: "Feathered Blade Approaching"
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Asaba Harumasa's Mindscape: Tacit Understanding
detail.desc2:
A card with Asaba Harumasa's personal picture printed on it.
"Ahem... I'm not one of those powerful recon soldiers, agile and able to travel thousands of miles for a surprise strike..."
"But my arrows are pretty fast, hm... Probably faster than anything that would attempt to take your life."
